description: This file defines the `GenericServiceJob` class, which represents a generic asynchronous service execution job within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages the lifecycle of running a service, handling success and failure scenarios, and interacts with related components such as dispatchers and requesters.

classes.name: GenericServiceJob
classes.description: Represents a generic asynchronous service job that manages execution, success, and failure states within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the associated service, handles success or failure, and communicates results or exceptions via the requester.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the job before executing the service; can be extended for additional setup.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Handles post-success logic after service completes successfully.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles logic when the service execution fails, logs errors, and updates the job state.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the context map used for service invocation.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to be invoked.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the job is in a valid state for execution.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Overrides dequeue behavior to prevent re-queuing the job once scheduled.
